description: Seat a guest who arrives without a reservation. Defaults the time to now in the venue timezone. Guest fields are guestName, guestContact and consent, or the same as a guest object with name, contact and consent. Pass the same idempotencyKey when you retry after a timeout or an error. Without it a retry is a new write and may create a duplicate.

commentary.description: A short note for staff about this booking, up to 500 characters, such as an occasion. Never put allergies, medical conditions, or diet needs here. Empty string clears it.

consent.description: Whether the guest allows being contacted after the visit. Omit if never asked.

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

guest.description: Same as the flat guestName, guestContact and consent fields, in the shape the HTTP API uses. Pass one or the other.

consent.description: Whether the guest allows being contacted after the visit. Omit if never asked.

idempotencyKey.description: Any unique string for this write. Send the same one again to retry it. Omit it and the server makes a new one.

rating.description: The guest's rating of the visit, 1 to 5. Omit if not given. Null clears it.

time.description: Time as HH:MM. Defaults to now.

name: reservation.walk_in
title: Walk-in
